claims.claim: The Acer M550 is the perfect projector for your living room with its native 4k UHD (3840 x 2160)
claims.evidence: No model number visible in photos; no screen output shown; no proof of 4K resolution or model identity.

risks.risk: The projector may not be the claimed model (Acer M550) or may not support 4K UHD resolution.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label or serial number plate, ideally on the bottom or rear of the unit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Acer projector without 4K capability, which is significantly lower than 4K models.

risks.risk: The projector may be non-functional or have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the projector powered on, projecting an image, and displaying 4K content if claimed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which reduces value to scrap or parts.

risks.risk: The projector may be missing essential accessories (remote, cables, power adapter) or have damaged ports.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories and a close-up of each port on the rear panel to confirm they are intact.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing accessories or with potential port damage, reducing value.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the model label or serial number plate on the projector.
A video clip showing the projector powered on and projecting an image.
A photo of all included accessories and a close-up of the rear ports.
response.reason: The model and key features (like 4K resolution) are not verifiable from the photos. Without proof of model identity and functionality, the item cannot be priced accurately and carries significant risk of being misrepresented.
